description_for_human: Generate 3D geometry for 2,650+ mathematically exact shapes — topology, quantum physics, DNA structures, IFS fractals, and more. Returns vertices, normals, and UVs ready for Three.js, Unity, or any 3D engine.
description_for_model: Use this to compute 3D parametric surface data for any named mathematical shape. Supports 26 real-time parameters (A-Z) per shape, covers 151+ categories including topology, quantum geometry, general relativity, DNA structures, IFS fractals, and non-Euclidean geometry. Returns vertex arrays (x,y,z), normals, UVs, and face indices in JSON. Exports GLB, PLY, and NeRF formats. All public endpoints are free with no API key.
